say:1:1320831001:1.text: You're darn lucky that we found your bevel knife!
say:1:1320831001:1.source_cn: 算你运气好，雕刻刀被我们找到了！

say:2:1320831002:1.text: Yes, Master Hugin. I'm awake and alert now.
say:2:1320831002:1.source_cn: 嗯……呼金老师，我现在清醒了。

say:3:1320831003:1.text: Really? Seems to me you still have a long way to go!

say:4:1320831004:1.text: Take care of Danica. She was upset when you lost your way. She loved being held by you. She said your hands were once clean and steady. The real hands of a craftsman, she said, but then you started going to the tavern...
say:4:1320831004:1.source_cn: 照顾好丹妮卡，她和你走丢的时候很不安。她喜欢被你的手持...

choice_prompt:5:1320831004.text: Take care of Danica. She was upset when you lost your way. She loved being held by you. She said your hands were once clean and steady. The real hands of a craftsman, she said, but then you started going to the tavern...
choice_prompt:5:1320831004.source_cn: 照顾好丹妮卡，她和你走丢的时候很不安。她喜欢被你的手持握——她说你的手曾经干净又稳定，是一双工匠的手，而不该去拿酒瓶！

say:6:1320831005:1.source_cn: 这可能很难，但我会尽量克制！

say:9:1320831011:1.text: So you start by melting the ice blocks on Artisan Avenue, and then you move to the processing area to shape and carve the ice sculpture...
say:9:1320831011:1.source_cn: 所以你们在工匠街熔炼开采出的矿石，然后在作业区对冰雕原...

say:10:1320831012:1.text: So, how was the ice sculpture transported to the lighting ceremony? It's huge.
say:10:1320831012:1.source_cn: 那么，最后冰雕是怎样运送到目的地的呢？那座雕像那么巨大！

say:11:1320831013:1.text: To make the deadline, we craft the finished product in sections before joining 'em. Once a part's ready, it's shipped to where the sculpture is to be erected. Once all pieces arrive, it's time to put the whole thing together.
say:11:1320831013:1.source_cn: 哦，为了赶工期，我们会将成品分块雕刻后再组装，一旦有某...

say:12:1320831014:1.text: What about the transport team? When do they arrive?

say:14:1320831015:1.text: They should've left as planned and should be here soon.
say:14:1320831015:1.source_cn: 他们应该已经按计划出发了，在来的路上。

say:15:1320831016:1.text: Hmph! Then they're about to be late. Is the transportation route still the same as before?
say:15:1320831016:1.source_cn: 哼，那他们快要迟到了。运输路线还和以前一样吗？

say:16:1320831017:1.text: No, the transport team said they found a better route and improved the transportation process. They're now taking the riverfront route on the <style="highlight">south side of Cedartown</style>. They'll be coming over the bridge on the southwest side.
say:16:1320831017:1.source_cn: 不，运输队优化了路线，他们现在改走<style=hig...

say:17:1320831018:1.text: The southern riverfront route...? That's the long way! Taking the mountain road on the east side and crossing the flower fields is the shortest distance.
say:17:1320831018:1.source_cn: 南侧的河岸线……？他们绕路了，走镇东侧的山路、穿越花海...

say:18:1320831019:1.text: I've combed over all procedures, processes, and routes. Each has its own problems. I hope that the transport team knows what they're doing with this "improvement" of theirs!
say:18:1320831019:1.source_cn: 关键节点上的其他流程我都已经检查过了，各有各的问题。希...

say:20:1320831020:1.text: This seems to be the last part of the operation that needs to be checked.
say:20:1320831020:1.source_cn: 听起来，这好像是要检查的最后环节了。

say:21:1320831021:1.text: Then let's go to the southwestern side of Cedartown and wait for them at the bridge!
say:21:1320831021:1.source_cn: 那我们去雪松镇西南侧的桥上等他们吧！

choice:5:0:1.text: Spend less time at the tavern.
choice:5:0:1.male: Spend less time at the tavern.
choice:5:0:1.female: Spend less time at the tavern.

say:27:1320831008:1.text: Of course. Master Hugin, I sincerely apologize for my behavior. I am inexperienced and far from standing on my own.
say:27:1320831008:1.source_cn: 应该的……老师……我还太青涩，离独当一面还差得远。

say:28:1320831009:1.text: That's more like it. A true craftsman views himself as a work in progress, always improving, scrutinizing myself, and toiling away until everything is perfect.
say:28:1320831009:1.source_cn: 哼，这话还差不多。优秀的工匠要将自己视作一件永远需要打...
